import_green_button.name: Import Green Button export
import_green_button.description: Imports usage history from a Green Button XML export downloaded from your Dominion Energy billing profile. The API only serves about 68 days of interval data; a Green Button export covers roughly 13 months, so this extends your Energy Dashboard history well past what polling can reach.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Dominion Energy account and meter to import into.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Full path to the Green Button XML file. Home Assistant can only read from directories in allowlist_external_dirs - by default your media directory and config/www, NOT the config directory itself. Prefer /media/, since files under www are served publicly without authentication. Add-ons show the config directory as /homeassistant, but this runs in Core where it is /config. Supply several paths to merge multiple exports; later files win on any hour they share.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Report what would be imported without writing any statistics. Use this first to check the date range and the timestamp alignment result.
